.desc — your one line

.desc <text> sets the phrase that follows your name in .who and
.examine. With the information from .profile it is what strangers
can see of you.

.desc on its own SHOWS you what yours says. If the words are your
own it then asks "Clear it? (y/n)" — only a plain y empties it, so
Enter or anything else leaves it alone. If you have written nothing
and the house gives you a line instead, you are shown that and asked
nothing: there is nothing of yours to clear.
